card.name: Words inside all-caps text
card.fires_on: Words written in all capital letters in running text, such as THE, AVAILABLE, PARK, or part of a word like DEPRESSANTS. It fires in warning-style or heading-style passages set entirely in capitals.

modes.label: Short linking words in caps
modes.description: Small words such as THE or THIS in an all-caps phrase.

modes.label: Content words in caps
modes.description: Nouns, adjectives or word parts completing an all-caps phrase.
